beats.what_happened: kishore reads the final constable list aloud and rupa's roll number is not on it.

state_changes.fact: publicly not selected for the constable post

beats.what_happened: kishore tells rupa in front of the ground that half the candidates have paid somebody and that she should ask her father for the money back.

state_changes.fact: humiliated in front of two hundred candidates
named in public as the man who paid

beats.what_happened: kishore shows rupa the pencil strike against her roll number and reads its margin date: the eleventh of the eighth month of the previous year.

state_changes.fact: knows her name was struck eleven months before the list was read

beats.what_happened: a pencil line was drawn through roll number one-nine-six on the district roll and initialled in the margin, two days after hariya's thumb impression was taken.

state_changes.fact: removed from the roll before the examination was ever held

beats.what_happened: the engagement sweets are returned to the house with the string still tied, and the messenger does not step onto the verandah.

state_changes.fact: engagement broken in view of the village road

beats.what_happened: rupa checks the co-operative register for the month of March and finds no loan recorded against the family house.

state_changes.fact: knows the ninety thousand did not come from the co-operative

beats.what_happened: hariya admits the house paper is with lakhan against ninety thousand at five per cent monthly, first instalment due on the fifth.

state_changes.fact: mortgage disclosed to his daughter
carries the family's debt from this point

beats.what_happened: lakhan takes the first instalment as due on the fifth and records it without dismounting; hariya asks for four days' grace to Saturday.

state_changes.fact: first instalment will be four days late

beats.what_happened: nagesh finds rupa at the tea shop, says he heard she asked the sub-inspector to read the list again, and offers her assisting work at eighteen thousand a month.

state_changes.fact: offered employment by nagesh

beats.what_happened: nagesh produces a khaki shirt with the initial already stitched and a joining letter whose posting address is the first floor of hotel mayur, above the bus stand.

state_changes.fact: holds a joining letter for an office that does not exist in law

beats.what_happened: rupa joins, is given the fourth complaints register, and finds fourteen people already waiting on the verandah bench.

state_changes.fact: in post at the first floor

beats.what_happened: ratan tells rupa his daily rate is five hundred rupees; rupa takes it as a joke and does not act on it.

state_changes.fact: has been told the truth about the office and has discarded it

beats.what_happened: sarita reports her son phulchand missing after a labour contractor took twenty-two people and returned with twenty-one; rupa records the statement and reads it back to her.

state_changes.fact: has a written complaint for the first time
records the discrepancy of twenty-two against twenty-one

beats.what_happened: rupa notices that the office rubber stamp she has pressed on fourteen files spells the district BARHAGRAH.

state_changes.fact: holds the first physical evidence that the office is not what it claims

beats.what_happened: nagesh explains the misspelt stamp as the work of an old stamp maker with failing eyes and rupa accepts the explanation.

state_changes.fact: suspicion neutralised for now

beats.what_happened: rupa serves dularchand's land notice on survey plot two-one-nine in uniform and the village street identifies her aloud as hariya's daughter serving papers for dularchand.

state_changes.fact: publicly shamed nine kilometres from her own house
has the state's appearance working for him

beats.what_happened: dularchand tells rupa that the seed godown compound is canal-side land, that her father has occupied the quarters nineteen years without a lease, and that the sixth notice is already typed.

state_changes.fact: his quarters are now leverage against his daughter

beats.what_happened: rupa makes bansi read out the twenty-two advance names and countersign that they were read on that date.

state_changes.fact: on record as having taken twenty-two people

beats.what_happened: rupa finds phulchand at the second kiln, working off a claimed four thousand rupees for an axle worth eleven hundred, and brings him back on the four o'clock bus.

state_changes.fact: recovered
has done what the real station did not

beats.what_happened: sarita tells the bus stand crowd what rupa did, and that nobody had ever read a complaint back to her before.

state_changes.fact: reputation established by mouth across the block

beats.location: hariya's verandah / bus stand ticket window
beats.what_happened: rupa's first salary of eighteen thousand is counted out and allocated, the returned sweets are refused by munni, and tapan salutes rupa at the ticket window in front of the queue.

state_changes.fact: instalment secured; house paper stays with lakhan but is not called
saluted by a constable of the real station in public

beats.what_happened: nagesh refuses to let rupa carry the kachhwara file to the real station, keeping all forwarding to himself, and sets her a target of forty files in ten days tied to her confirmation.

state_changes.fact: sole control of what leaves the office
under a production target

beats.what_happened: rupa files forty-four in nine days and kajri asks her to divert all sonbarsa matters to her table without writing them in the register.

state_changes.fact: has an off-book arrangement she needs protected

beats.what_happened: pushpa states without counting that confirmation falls on the fifth, and deflects rupa's question about whether kajri was ever confirmed.

state_changes.fact: second inconsistency logged

beats.what_happened: rupa reads the reverse of lakhan's receipt and finds the clause allowing the whole principal to be called on the fifth of any month, the first instalment having been four days late.

state_changes.fact: knows the house can be called at any time

beats.what_happened: rupa spends half a day at the district office asking which department an assisting station belongs to and is sent to counter nine, which is shut until the fourteenth; she enters both days in the office leave book.

state_changes.fact: has begun a written trail of her own enquiry

beats.what_happened: behind a shut door rupa tells kajri she will go to counter nine on the fourteenth and ask which department pays them.

state_changes.fact: holds something worth trading

beats.what_happened: nagesh discovers kajri has taken thirty-one thousand rupees in sonbarsa matters on her own account and demands she bring him something in exchange for it being overlooked; she gives him rupa's storeroom sentence.

state_changes.fact: bought her position with rupa's words

beats.what_happened: nagesh repeats rupa's storeroom sentence back to her word for word and advises her to go to counter nine at eleven rather than nine.

state_changes.fact: knows she was betrayed by the one person she confided in

beats.what_happened: the establishment officer tells rupa there is no temporary wing, no assisting station, no cadre and no head of account, and points out that her joining letter's seal is misspelt.

state_changes.fact: knows the office has no legal existence

beats.what_happened: nagesh denies nothing, admits the misspelt stamp is deliberate, admits there was never a second candidate in sonbarsa, and confirms ratan is paid five hundred a day.

state_changes.fact: has stopped pretending to rupa

beats.what_happened: nagesh sets out that exposing the office destroys four hundred and nine matters, and offers rupa the register, twenty-eight thousand and one rupee in ten, showing her that in eight months not one page has been signed by anybody.

state_changes.fact: offered the mechanism and its liability together

beats.what_happened: nagesh states he never touched rupa's ninety thousand and tells her to remember that he said so first.

state_changes.fact: given a marker she does not yet understand

beats.what_happened: on the fourth morning rupa signs her first file, a stolen buffalo matter, and takes charge of the register.

state_changes.fact: personally liable from this date
in charge of complaints, notices and the bench

beats.what_happened: rupa copies out the receiving file at night — eighty-one of dularchand's notices with signatures, dates and witnesses.

state_changes.fact: holds proof of service on eighty-one notices

beats.location: first floor, hotel mayur, door open to the staircase
beats.what_happened: rupa confronts dularchand with the receivings and the non-existence of the office; he withdraws all four canal-side matters aloud, names sukhdev, tears the typed notice on the seed godown compound, and counts out fifty-five thousand rupees.

state_changes.fact: beaten in public and out of pocket
threat to the godown quarters removed
first public reversal

beats.what_happened: dularchand asks who taught rupa to draft a notice like that and she names page ninety-four of a second-hand examination guide.

state_changes.fact: acknowledged as competent by the man who used her

beats.location: hotel mayur, ground floor and staircase
beats.what_happened: kishore conducts a hotel register verification of the whole building and climbs the iron staircase to the first floor.

state_changes.fact: the real police are inside the mechanism

beats.what_happened: kishore examines the register, finds the receiving column, states that no station in the district keeps one, and admits in the room that the kachhwara matter reached his desk four times and he put it in the pile on the left each time.

state_changes.fact: publicly owns his failure
her method endorsed by the real station

beats.what_happened: kishore instructs rupa to bring the kachhwara file to him personally once it returns from forwarding, and tells the room that this is what file work should look like before asking her which recruitment batch she is from.

state_changes.fact: acknowledged out loud by the man who read her off the list, who does not recognise her

beats.what_happened: the kachhwara file was carried in an envelope to bansi's brother's house and nineteen thousand rupees changed hands for it to remain in a drawer.

state_changes.fact: her case was sold before it was ever forwarded

beats.what_happened: sarita reports that the real police have arrested phulchand on bansi's brother's complaint of theft of four thousand rupees.

state_changes.fact: in custody

beats.what_happened: nagesh states that nothing has ever been forwarded from the office and that he sold the kachhwara file to bansi's brother for nineteen thousand rupees.

state_changes.fact: learns her best work was converted into a weapon against the complainant
the mechanism stated aloud in front of witnesses

beats.what_happened: sarita says the district court clerk told her there is no barhagarh sahayak thana on any list and asked her whose handwriting the file was in; she demands rupa answer in front of the bench.

state_changes.fact: publicly accused by the person she helped
hears that the office does not exist

beats.what_happened: lakhan calls the entire principal of ninety thousand for the fifth of the following month under the late-instalment clause, saying he was asked a question about the house by a man he will not name.

state_changes.fact: house callable in thirty days

beats.what_happened: pushpa reveals the office is being packed for a lorry to patna on the sixth and that nagesh told her there is no place for her window there; rupa offers her two rooms at kachhwara funded from the unclaimed part of dularchand's fifty-five thousand in exchange for the receipt book.

state_changes.fact: turns against nagesh

beats.what_happened: the receipt book is lifted from under the scheme window floorboard; it records three years of money taken for posts that do not exist, including kajri's fifty-five thousand.

state_changes.fact: holds the only document that names nagesh's takings

beats.what_happened: page four records ninety thousand received from hariya against the post of constable, candidate rupa, thumb impression dated the ninth of the eighth month of the previous year — seven weeks before the recruitment notice was published and two days before her name was struck from the roll.

state_changes.fact: knows she was never a candidate; the vacancy was the collection method
his lie about March exposed to his daughter

beats.what_happened: hariya states in front of the tea shop bench that he paid ninety thousand on the ninth of the eighth month, seven weeks before the notice was published, that he mortgaged the house in March to make it good, and that he called it a tractor loan.

state_changes.fact: his shame told by himself rather than found out

beats.what_happened: rupa pays lakhan the ninety thousand principal from six months of her own commission; lakhan dismounts, returns the property paper and reads the discharge receipt aloud.

state_changes.fact: house and front land redeemed
the debt that started the story is closed

beats.what_happened: rupa delivers four registers, the receiving file, bansi's advance book, the receipt book and an unsigned statement admitting she signed three hundred and one files knowing the office had no existence, and signs it in front of kishore; kishore rules that the receiving column makes all four hundred and nine matters transferable into the real register.

state_changes.fact: under enquiry and on record by her own hand

state_changes.entity: the four hundred and nine complainants
state_changes.fact: their matters survive the collapse of the office

beats.what_happened: kishore suspends the reading of the list, announces the receipt book will be read out entry by entry, states that no sahayak thana ever existed and that all four hundred and nine matters are being taken into the real register, has nagesh walked across the ground, withdraws the complaint against phulchand and registers twenty-two counts against the labour contractor, sets aside the pencil strike on roll one-nine-six and names rupa to the ground while stating she is under enquiry for what she signed.

state_changes.fact: taken in front of the ground where he recruited her
the reversal is public, in front of the witnesses to episode one
her son's case is real
examination form accepted, roll four-eleven

beats.what_happened: a table is put out in the compound of the real station with a chair on either side, and rupa writes case number one into the real register and stamps it with a stamp that spells the district correctly.

state_changes.fact: doing the same work inside a real institution
